mission: Advance the next independent non-P0 provenance wound without touching the gated phone/P0 chain or creating duplicate architecture.

sourceBoundary.currentWound: One unreadable or malformed-UTF-8 skills/**/SKILL.md can abort direct skill discovery during hash/title extraction instead of becoming a bounded structured discoveryErrors entry.
sourceBoundary.authorizedLane: GitHub repository/source mutation and readback only

fronts.name: provenance-error-isolation
fronts.action: Make per-file hash/title failures structured, bounded, fail-closed, and non-fatal to discovery of unrelated skills.

fronts.name: hostile-regression-source
fronts.action: Add malformed UTF-8 and deterministic I/O-failure fixtures proving healthy skills survive and strict mode still sees discovery errors.

fronts.name: durable-skill-doctrine
fronts.action: Synchronize heartbeat-skill-provenance-freshness with per-file error isolation and source/test/runtime capability separation.

fronts.name: accessible-warm-wall
fronts.action: If the provenance topology materially changes, mutate the existing source specimen in place with a partial-discovery/file-fault-isolated state; preserve radio/keyboard/touch/non-color/reduced-motion semantics.

fronts.name: evidence-repair
fronts.action: Treat prior Command Center/Computer Hands queue state as historical because current Home Center readback says Command Center Codex jobs/workers are permanently retired; do not substitute Phone Hands.

fronts.name: judgment-and-capability
fronts.action: Run code-first Regnet/Venice-style bounded review, attempt authoritative She-Raw without impersonation, and preserve requested/implemented/tested/runtime/deployed/delivered/accepted distinctions.

reviewCriteria: A malformed or unreadable individual SKILL.md cannot abort the report.
The failing file cannot earn repository_skill authority.
Unrelated valid skills remain discoverable in deterministic order.
Errors expose bounded structured fields, not raw exception prose or hostile file contents.
Strict mode still treats discoveryErrors as a failure boundary.
No phone/P0 surface or duplicate controller/daemon is consumed or created.
Repository source progress is not reported as tested, runtime, deployed, delivered, or accepted.

reviewerStateBeforeMutation.venice: criteria recorded; no external Venice connector authority claimed
